content: Kunlai Bu Kielie
Xianxin gieku zholientu kunlai ta jienlie. Ijien buxianshi bu jianjindu.
Niezhan kunla yanniliuzhe ijiese olune giezhi xianxin giezho. Xianxin gieku zholientu kunla zinie cai ijiene.
Migha ijiesan kunla migha ese ijiesan kunlai meilade bu uzhe, migha ese ijiesan kunla migha ijiesan kunlai bu kielie. Huda hhelai jienliewo.
Kunlai hojii kieliezhi chishi kien wo? Hhela olu, ulie olu ezhanyini shiqin wo. Ezhande olughaku nengou wine. Ingiese hhe olu shidane.
Niezhan kunla enenie udui psedu udulase zhunyo wo giezho. Niezhan kunla niuduniei uzhedan niekielien wo giezho. Alinie kunliuzhe zhughedene oluzhou ese olusei jiejin gie gie.
Udu jilasan kunla Ezhande oluzhi udu jilazho. Ijiesan kunla Hudade mafan giedene Ezhande oluzhi ijiezho. Ese ijiesan kunlaye Hudade mafan kieliedene Ezhande oluzhi ese ijiezho.
Matan alinie kunliuzhe goyadene oluzhi ese amiturazho. Goyadene oluzhiye ulie fugune.
Matan amitushi Ezhande oluzhi amiturazho. Fuguseye Ezhande oluzhi fugune. Ingiese matan amitura, fuguliuzhe Ezhannughun wo.
Mexiha fugusan kun, amitu kunde Ezhan danlane giezhi duya ijiedene aminne oluwo.
Matan man Hudai shenpantai melie beine. Chi yale gaijiune kieliene? Chi yale gaijiune meilade uzhene?
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun,

content.text: Soyuji amanla bishi Huda wo giezhi chenren giene.'"

content: Ingiese matan alinie kunliuzhe Hudai melie goyane shiqinyi jiodai giene.
Gaijiulane Zui Bu Fanjigha
Ingiese matan nieniene bu kielieye. Jiexin xiaizhi gaijiulai melie boujia, banjighaku dunxii bu tei.
Bi Ezhan Ersai xianxin giezhi kenjin mejiene. Yandeliuzhe benshen ganjin wituni uwo. Zinie kun ganjin uwo giese hhende ganjin uwo.
Chi ijiunighala gaijiulane munan gieghase oreku daolighala ese giezho. Mexiha hhende oluzhi duya ijiewo, chi goyane ijiunighala hhei baxi bu olugha.
Ingiese ta goya gounine kunlai bu sugiegha.
Hudai gojiashi ijieku, ochiku pusho, Shenlin ogisan gundan, heqi, bayasuku wo.
Mexihani ingiezhi shunjisan kunde Huda bayasune, kunlaye kuaine.
Ingiese matan heqituzhi nieniene hendaghakui xiacha gieye.
Ijiunighala Hudai wiliei bu qida olugha. Manshi ganjinni woma, chi ijiedene kunlai zui fanjighase ese oluzho.
Migha ijie, jiu ochi, pse yan shiqindeliuzhe gaijiulani zui fanjighakui ulie giese gou wo.
Chi xianxin giesanne Hudai melie goude barei. Kun goyane gou wo giesan shiqinyi giedene gui ulie teise fuqi wine.
Inxin giezhi ijiese zui jinjine. Xianxin giekughala ese ijiezho. Xianxin giekughala giesanni pushoshi man zui wo.
